description: Two distinct loaded monster records, zero conditions/statuses and no present characters or combat auras. Shared spell identifiers without a visual descriptor are tested as party application or refresh of a matching monster slot; fresh monster visual cases use identifiers with a valid descriptor. SR.DLL display/resource stubs share the fixture contract of case 005242b0; rule children execute unchanged. Outputs cover all slots, complete modifier buffers and application/UI refresh flags; rendering objects and derived monster attack caches are outside the interface.
